answered.sql: SELECT F.title FROM Films F JOIN Film_Genres FG ON F.film_id = FG.film_id JOIN Genres G ON FG.film_genre_id = G.id JOIN Film_Stars FS ON F.film_id = FS.film_id JOIN Stars S ON FS.film_star_id = S.id WHERE S.star_name = 'Tom Cruise' AND (G.genre = 'Action' OR G.genre = 'Adventure')

candidates.meaning: Display action films and adventure films which star Tom Cruise.
candidates.sql: SELECT F.title FROM Films F JOIN Film_Genres FG ON F.film_id = FG.film_id JOIN Genres G ON FG.film_genre_id = G.id JOIN Film_Stars FS ON F.film_id = FS.film_id JOIN Stars S ON FS.film_star_id = S.id WHERE S.star_name = 'Tom Cruise' AND (G.genre = 'Action' OR G.genre = 'Adventure')

candidates.meaning: Select films where Tom Cruise stars and the film is either an action or adventure genre.
candidates.sql: SELECT F.title FROM Films F JOIN Film_Stars FS ON F.film_id = FS.film_id JOIN Stars S ON FS.film_star_id = S.id WHERE S.star_name = 'Tom Cruise' AND F.film_id IN (SELECT FG.film_id FROM Film_Genres FG JOIN Genres G ON FG.film_genre_id = G.id WHERE G.genre IN ('Action', 'Adventure'))

candidates.meaning: Select distinct films where Tom Cruise stars and the film is either an action or adventure genre, without duplicates.
candidates.sql: SELECT DISTINCT F.title FROM Films F JOIN Film_Stars FS ON F.film_id = FS.film_id JOIN Stars S ON FS.film_star_id = S.id WHERE S.star_name = 'Tom Cruise' AND F.film_id IN (SELECT FG.film_id FROM Film_Genres FG JOIN Genres G ON FG.film_genre_id = G.id WHERE G.genre IN ('Action', 'Adventure'))
